ModMetaData.name: Tobe's Dining Room (Continued)
ModMetaData.author: totobrother
ModMetaData.description:
[img]https://img.litet.net/logos/Info.png[/img] Update of totobrothers mod https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1184694645
- Should no longer conflict with the fountain from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=836308268]Dubs Bad Hygiene[/url]. If you build a fountain before adding Dubs mod it will be replaced with a drinking fountain on first load. Also added plumbing and water-storage to the fountain. - Fixed the table-textures. Now pawns wont try to eat beside the table-surface - Russian translation added, thanks Dmitry6!
